name: Barnsley Fern
desc: The iconic Barnsley fern grown by a chaos game of four affine maps, its self-similar fronds accumulating in luminous height-graded green (deep base to chartreuse tips), swaying on the clock and re-sprouting variant ferns each section, with autumn, bioluminescent, frost, and sumi-ink alternates.

density.doc: chaos-game points per frame (sparse -> dense frond)

fronds.doc: number of offset/mirrored fronds filling the width
